attributes.title: ARAPA 2027 CME Conference
attributes.series: Arkansas Academy of Physician Associates CME Conference
attributes.organizer: The Arkansas Academy of Physician Assistants
attributes.summary:
A compact two-day option for Arkansas PAs: March 5 and 6, 2027, at Chenal Country Club in Little Rock. The academy plans 12 AAPA Category 1 CME credits, but the activity is still awaiting review by the AAPA panel, so treat that number as provisional until it is designated.

The ticket covers both days, the Friday social event and online recordings afterward. Handouts are digital, so download them first. Full-conference registration is $350 for ARAPA members and $475 for nonmembers, or $297.50 and $403.75 at the early-bird rate through January 1, 2027. Single days cost $200 for members and $250 for nonmembers.
